# appdynamics_policies (Data Source)

Lists the alert policies defined for an AppDynamics business application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_policies" "all" {
  application_id = 42
}

output "policy_names" {
  value = { for p in data.appdynamics_policies.all.policies : p.id => p.name }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application to list policies for.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) The policies defined for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) Policy ID.
- `name` (String)
